app: In the Google Admin console (admin.google.com) go to Security > Access and data control > SSO with third-party IdP and open the SSO profile (check your app's current UI - older consoles show it under Security > Set up single sign-on).
Set the sign-in page URL to {idp_sso_url} and the sign-out page URL to {idp_logout_url}, then upload the verification certificate from {idp_cert_url}.

Decide on the issuer: with 'Use a domain-specific issuer' checked Google's entity ID is google.com/a/{domain}; unchecked it is plain google.com - the FlareID entity_id must match whichever you choose.
Google signs users in by their primary email address, so the SAML NameID must be that address.
Assign the SSO profile to all users or to specific organizational units, then test with a non-admin account.
flareid: Add a SAML service provider (Admin > Applications > SAML service providers > New) and apply this template.
Replace {domain} in the entity ID and ACS URL with the Workspace primary domain, or set entity_id to google.com if you did not check the domain-specific issuer box.
Keep NameID format emailAddress - Google matches it to the user's primary email.
No attribute statements are required; Google ignores extra attributes for basic SSO.
